quote.text: To be always fortunate, and to pass through life with a soul that has never known sorrow, is to be ignorant of one half of nature.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the challenges of raising children as vital learning moments; just as sorrow deepens our understanding, parenting through hardships cultivates empathy and resilience in both you and your child.
    • Recognize that shielding your children from every hardship might deny them the opportunity to experience growth; the balance between joy and sorrow teaches them the full spectrum of human nature.
  • Leadership
    • Understand that adversity and sorrow are not weaknesses but integral parts of leadership; facing difficulties head-on builds character and inspires trust in your team.
    • Remember that a leader who has weathered storms can guide others through their own challenges by offering authentic insight into overcoming trials and learning from them.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, setbacks and failures are invaluable; each obstacle encountered provides lessons that refine strategies and foster innovation.
    • Accept that a product's journey, much like the human experience, involves highs and lows—understanding this duality encourages a balanced perspective when making critical decisions.
